# Checkbox (`checkbox`)

Checkbox with indeterminate state, and checkbox groups.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createCheckbox` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/checkbox.d.ts`): `.mh-checkbox`: a native checkbox (drawn by CSS, so the platform keeps its keyboard and screen-reader behaviour) with a label and optional description. `indeterminate` shows a dash and reads as "mixed".

```ts
export function createCheckbox(options: CheckboxOptions): CheckboxHandle;

export interface CheckboxOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** A second line under the label (announced as the description). */
  description?: string;
  checked?: boolean;
  /** Mixed state, e.g. a "select all" over a partly selected list. Cleared when the user toggles it. */
  indeterminate?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  name?: string;
  value?: string;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface CheckboxHandle {
  el: HTMLLabelElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  isChecked(): boolean;
  setChecked(checked: boolean): void;
  setIndeterminate(indeterminate: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createCheckbox } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom'];

const all = createCheckbox({
  label: 'All rooms',
  onChange: (checked) => {
    for (const box of boxes) box.setChecked(checked);
  },
});

const boxes = rooms.map((room, i) => createCheckbox({ label: room, checked: i === 1, onChange: syncAll }));

// "All rooms" is checked when every room is, and indeterminate when only some are.
function syncAll(): void {
  const count = boxes.filter((box) => box.input.checked).length;
  all.setChecked(count === boxes.length);
  all.setIndeterminate(count > 0 && count < boxes.length);
}

syncAll();
document.body.append(all.el, ...boxes.map((box) => box.el));
```

## React API

`Checkbox` (types in `dist/react/choice-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createCheckbox`.

```ts
export function Checkbox({ label, description, indeterminate = false, className, ...rest }: CheckboxProps);

export interface CheckboxProps extends NativeCheckbox {
  label?: ReactNode;
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Mixed state; set it from your data (the DOM property is applied after render). */
  indeterminate?: boolean;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const ROOMS = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom'];

export function CheckboxExample() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>(['Kitchen']);
  const toggle = (room: string, on: boolean) =>
    setChosen((rooms) => (on ? [...rooms, room] : rooms.filter((r) => r !== room)));
  return (
    <div>
      <Checkbox
        label="All rooms"
        checked={chosen.length === ROOMS.length}
        indeterminate={chosen.length > 0 && chosen.length < ROOMS.length}
        onChange={(e) => setChosen(e.target.checked ? [...ROOMS] : [])}
      />
      {ROOMS.map((room) => (
        <Checkbox
          key={room}
          label={room}
          checked={chosen.includes(room)}
          onChange={(e) => toggle(room, e.target.checked)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```
